item.title: Mechanical Horse
item.description:
I went for a walk in 📍Bois de la Cambre forest in Brussels and while enjoying nature, I spotted this mechanical horse. It seems to be made of scrap metal (sorry I forgot about the details).

Interesting thing is that it is placed in the middle of a huge forest, a surrounding with stark contrast to its nature.

I wonder what the artist wanted to convey.
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: Land of clouds
item.description:
This scene is mesmerising, especially when I am here watching it from window seat with my own eyes. It feels very similar to my imagination of being in a cold desert such as in Antartica. The clouds beneath are giving an illusion of a land extended till horizon and fully covered with ice.

Try to look, may be you can also find the same land of imagination.
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: Université Paris Cité
item.description:
I was here for a conference in last May 2025, walking around looking for the place of SD and AC. They are a nice couple and their kids are amazing.

Due to financial issues, after finishing my PhD, I could not stay at hotel. SD and AC saved me from this trouble and hosted me at their home. I spent three lovely days with them.

It’s an unforgettable memory.
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: Gandhi Ashram Meerut
item.description:
Its an Ashram in Meerut, India, which was built in 1920 to support Swadesh and Non-Violence moment.

It also acted as a small Khadi factory to hand build India’s own national flag.

Now after 90+ years its just a ruin but still standing here and imagining it full of Indian freedom fighters including Ghandhiji and Nehru—first prime minister—make me feel as if it were yesterday.
